title: [Main] -Detail Trial Balance - Running Balance Incorrect When "Include Closing Entries" Is Disabled
summary: Fixed the Detail Trial Balance report so that excluded closing entries no longer incorrectly accumulate into the running balance column, ensuring displayed balances reconcile with visible entries.
key_points: Closing entries that are skipped from printing were still contributing to the running balance calculation
Reordered the trigger to check and skip closing entries before accumulating amounts into GLBalance
Running balance now accurately reflects only the entries actually displayed on the report
Matches existing pattern used for reversed entries and corrections-only filters
Added test cases across multiple localization layers to verify the fix
quote: Reordered the trigger to compute ClosingEntry and perform CurrReport.Skip() before the GLBalance := GLBalance + Amount line
